shopcounter.description: an old wooden shop counter with a chunky vintage cash register, a charity collection tin, a bowl of sweets and a little bell on top, front panel of dark varnished wood

armycounter.description: an army surplus shop counter made of olive green ammunition crates with a glass display top showing combat knives, compasses and dog tags, an old cash register on top

betcounter.description: a betting shop counter with a thick glass security screen, slip trays and a small till, purple laminate front with a gold stripe, two tall stools in front

reception.description: a smart hotel reception desk in polished dark wood and cream marble top, a brass bell, a computer monitor and a small vase of white flowers

mannequin.description: a shop mannequin wearing a frumpy floral dress, a straw hat and a fake pearl necklace, standing on a round stand

camomannequin.description: a shop mannequin in full camouflage combat gear with a black gas mask and a green helmet, standing on a round stand

brictable.description: a wooden trestle table piled with charity shop bric-a-brac: mismatched crockery, a lamp with a tassel shade, porcelain dogs, board games and a stack of old VHS tapes, handwritten price labels

bookcase.description: a tall wooden bookcase crammed with old paperbacks, VHS tapes, jigsaw puzzles and a stuffed toy, seen from the front

camorack.description: a metal clothes rack hung with camouflage jackets, olive army trousers and a black bomber jacket, with combat boots lined up underneath

ammoboxes.description: a stack of olive green military ammo tins and a wooden crate stencilled with white letters, a coiled rope on top

betstand.description: a betting shop slip stand: a tall narrow counter with racks of blank betting slips and small blue pens on chains, a little bin of screwed up losing slips underneath

sofa.description: a hotel lobby sofa in dark green leather with brass studs, two cushions, a low glass coffee table in front with football magazines

bigplant.description: a tall potted indoor palm plant in a glossy black pot, hotel lobby decoration

luggage.description: a brass hotel luggage trolley loaded with football team kit bags and silver suitcases
